title: Multidentate extracting agents based on calix[4]arene scaffold – U(VI)/Eu(III) separation studies

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (24 mg, 53 µmol) in MeCN (3 mL) was added to a solution of L2 (50 mg, 49 µmol) and NEt3 (34 µL, 242 µmol) in MeCN (20 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 12 h, the solvent was partially removed under reduced pressure, and the yellow precipitate was filtered, washed with cold MeCN, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Partial removal of solvent under reduced pressure; yellow precipitate filtered, washed with cold MeCN, and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: UV/Vis absorption of the isolated yellow powder in acetonitrile shows bands at 203, 286, and 352 nm; no luminescence or magnetic data are reported for this solid.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear europium(III) complex of hydrolyzed 6-hydroxymethylpyridine-2-carbaldehyde hydrazone

synthesis.procedure: Slow evaporation of an acetonitrile solution of the isolated powder [Eu2(L2)2(NO3)x] hydrolyzed the calixarene-tethered substituents and deposited a few orange crystals of the tetranuclear complex of py-2-CH2O-6-CH=NNH2. The powder (15 mg, 6.3 µmol) was dissolved in MeCN (5 mL); crystals formed after 12 days.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Few orange crystals obtained by slow evaporation of MeCN; crystals mounted in mineral oil for single-crystal diffraction.
